subject: OpenAI and Google launch new flagship models
intro: This week saw major model releases from both OpenAI and Google, alongside new tooling updates for developers. These updates focus on improving reasoning capabilities and reducing costs for daily workflows.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.blurb: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, offering stronger professional performance, coding capabilities, and computer use at lower costs.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
items.blurb: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Neon, a model optimized for agentic coding, multi-step tool usage, and complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.blurb: Google introduced Tool Retrieval in preview for the Gemini API, enabling agents to dynamically select from hundreds of tools while cutting token usage.

items.title: Zero data retention with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards is now in beta
items.blurb: Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards are now in beta, offering misuse detection while ensuring no client data is retained.

items.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
items.blurb: Google Search can now connect to personal data in Drive, Wallet, and Gemini to provide more personalized and relevant responses.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2
items.blurb: The hardest work: long autonomous agent runs, science, deep analysis. Slow and pricey.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra
items.blurb: OpenAI's strongest: coding, computer and browser use, science, professional work. 'Astra Pro' is the same model with reasoning mode set to pro: thinks longer, better on hard tasks.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Sol
items.blurb: Strong reasoning for complex professional work at a mid-tier price. In ChatGPT on Plus and up. 'Sol Pro' = same model, pro reasoning mode.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon
items.blurb: Google's new flagship: deep work in coding, finance, law, security and science. Google's latest flagship model.

items.title: hitkeeen/blender-ai-mcp-addon
items.blurb: An AI assistant and Model Context Protocol server addon for Blender that inspects 3D scenes, builds objects, edits materials, and automates multi-step visual workflows. Heads-up: The release package targets Windows x64 with Blender 4.2 or later, and the built-in Python tool validation is not a security sandbox.

items.title: ersinkoc/phonebox
items.blurb: PhoneBox converts an old Android phone into a touch control deck and desk display for computer stats, media, and AI coding session details. Heads-up: Windows desktop agent builds are currently unsigned and may trigger antivirus or SmartScreen warnings.

items.title: dabingfy-dot/solo-to-team-skills
items.blurb: A toolkit of roles, review templates, and platform-specific skills for running multi-agent workflows with human oversight. Heads-up: Early version (v0.2.0); full native integration across all four target platforms is not fully verified, and role names do not provide true data isolation between agents.

items.title: Kimberlying/ai-engineering-interview-100
items.blurb: A collection of 100 production-focused interview questions, diagnostic playbooks, and system design architectures for AI engineering.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.blurb: An AI agent skill that searches social platforms, news, market odds, and transcripts from the last 30 days to synthesize grounded summaries. Heads-up: Full platform coverage requires configuring API keys or active browser sessions for walled-garden services like X and YouTube.

items.title: kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill
items.blurb: A collection of 42 local FFmpeg tools and a tool server that give coding agents full video and audio editing capabilities. Heads-up: Requires local installations of FFmpeg and Python 3 on your system.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.blurb: A skill and command bundle that adds bug bounty workflows, vulnerability patterns, and external red-team techniques to coding assistants.

items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.blurb: An open-source desktop, web, and mobile control surface that lets you remotely manage coding agents running on your machine.

items.title: morluto/rea
items.blurb: Reverse engineer apps, binaries, and websites with AI agents.

items.title: zouyuxuan122/dsh-our-free-model
items.blurb: This is a free model plugin for dsh that adds frontier models like Muse Spark 1.3 and MiMo V2.6 with zero configuration, no sign-up, and no API keys required.

items.title: Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model
items.blurb: A zero-configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that provides free, unlimited access to advanced AI models without requiring API keys or accounts.

items.title: modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
items.blurb: The official Python SDK for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients.

items.title: vercel/ai
items.blurb: The AI SDK is Vercel's free TypeScript library for adding AI to web apps. It gives one API across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, plus UI hooks for building chat interfaces in React, Next.js, Svelte and Vue.

items.title: huggingface/transformers
items.blurb: Hugging Face Transformers is an open-source Python library to download, run, and train state-of-the-art machine learning models for text, vision, and audio.
